instruction.md:9 mandates Express and SQLite, yet tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:3 bans source/filesystem inspection and gates/constraints/prompt.md:9 says browser evidence cannot infer SQLite. A persistent JSON-backed Node server can satisfy all browser checks while violating the explicit stack mandate.
quality.counterexample: A builder can use a persistent JSON file with Node, pass browser gate and all product criteria, yet violate mandatory Express/SQLite from instruction.md:9.
quality.suggested_fix: Remove the task-added Express/SQLite mandate or add a separately authorized and reliable stack check outside the browser-only judge.

quality.evidence: functional/judge.toml:1-715 maps seeded data, formulae, roles, ledger, settlement, history and security to public hireops_rules.md:1-290; no additional unsupported UI labels/routes required.

functional/judge.toml:114-120 hro_offer_id_lifecycle combines unusual-ID approval and rescission into one binary outcome. Correct approval with broken rescission earns zero for both, despite separate product promises. hro_date_validation at :186 also combines create and rescind date refusal.
quality.counterexample: A submission may correctly approve an offer whose ID contains spaces and /?# but fail rescission routing; hro_offer_id_lifecycle at functional/judge.toml:114 awards zero for both independent actions. Likewise date validation across offer creation/rescission is one binary row at :186.
quality.suggested_fix: Split unusual-ID approval and rescission routing into independently scored outcomes; split separate date-action promises where partial correctness is independently useful.
